faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Reach us directly on WhatsApp.

items.a: Photobooth setup usually takes about 30 minutes, and our team arrives early to make sure everything is ready before the event starts.
Yes, contact our admin at least 3 days before the event to reschedule the date. Cancellation policy will be explained at booking confirmation.

items.q: Can the photobooth be used outdoors?
items.a: Yes, as long as there's a power source and a reasonably shaded area. Our team can help with a location survey if needed.

items.q: How much space is needed for setup?
items.a: About a 2x2 meter area is enough for the booth, backdrop, and comfortable guest space.

items.q: Is there a minimum rental duration?
items.a: Our smallest package starts at 2 hours, suitable for small to medium events.

items.q: Are digital files provided after the event?
items.a: Yes, all soft-copy photos can be downloaded via QR Code or sent by email after the event.

items.q: How does payment work, and is a deposit required?
items.a: Bookings are confirmed with a deposit to lock in the date, with the balance settled before or on the event day as agreed.

items.q: Do you serve areas outside Jabodetabek?
items.a: For now we focus on the Jabodetabek area. For other locations, please contact us to discuss further.
